title: Read-it-later app Pocket shut down down — here are the best alternatives | TechCrunch
summary: Though the app itself is free to use, you can pay $79.99 per year to unlock features like improved transcriptions for podcasts and YouTube videos, tools to adjust reading speed, and additional integrations with other apps like notes apps, Gmail, and Kindle.
